builds.name: Haymaker ceiling
builds.summary: Center Haymaker deals 160+(.25+.0025 AD[statFormula=2])*Grit. Grit cap is 50% max HP; Bloodmail converts health into AD, multiplying both axes. Armor penetration cannot help center true damage.
builds.goal: Center Haymaker deals 160+(.25+.0025 AD[statFormula=2])*Grit. Grit cap is 50% max HP; Bloodmail converts health into AD, multiplying both axes. Armor penetration cannot help center true damage.
builds.hypothesis:
Passive: Sett stores [100]% of damage taken as Grit, up to [(0.5) × Stat(12)]. Grit decays quickly [4] seconds after the damage was taken.

Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a [100]% Grit consumed Shield decaying over [3] seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing [80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160] plus [0.25 + (0.0025) × AD[statFormula=2]] Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max @f1@ damage). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage.
Heartsteel/Warmog/Titanic/Sterak/Shojin supply health; Bloodmail converts bonus HP and missing-health state into AD. Titanic is one Cleave family item. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready.

Earn exactly 500 Heartsteel HP by minute 30, set 10% self HP, fill Grit to cap then center W before decay. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Stored helper/statFormula or symbolic fields remain unresolved: validate live stat meanings/tick rules, do not silently infer. Unbounded earned stacks imply no finite global maximum; this entry uses the stated finite benchmark. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Heartsteel, Warmog's Armor, Overlord's Bloodmail, Sterak's Gage, Titanic Hydra, Spear of Shojin. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
